label.NSA: Unadjusted data (i.e. neither seasonally adjusted nor calendar adjusted data)

extension.description:
Quarterly non-financial transactions cover production, income generation, distribution and use, as well as consumption and capital investments.

The data is available broken down by institutional sectors (households, government, financial and non-financial corporations, and the rest of the world), illustrating their economic behaviour and interactions between them.

The series are calculated following the European System of Accounts (ESA 2010) methodology.
